patch_description: The current agent uses decayed movement counts (.965 retention, 45-count cap), a fresh hidden-enemy background each turn, and two-step risk planning. This rewrite introduces persistent, observation-filtered hidden occupancy with exactly three represented enemies; adaptive mixing of uniform, slow (.993 retention), and fast (.91 retention) movement estimators; and collision forecasts conditioned on surviving the first action. It retains exploration and route recovery while increasing second-step risk weight from .42 to .60. These changes aim to reduce avoidable deaths without excessive waiting; improved fitness requires evaluation.
